subject: religious-studies
source_note: World Religions is an SL-only IB Diploma course; there is no HL. Structure follows the IB Diploma World Religions guide: Part 1 (introduction to five world religions), Part 2 (in-depth study of two religions through themes, key concepts and key questions), the three underpinning questions, and the investigative study (IA). Connections, sequence and prerequisites are expert-authored teaching relationships (the IB does not publish these).
